full_track.tags: Bossa nova and jazz pop fusion. Nylon string acoustic guitar plays syncopated bossa nova chords and fingerstyle patterns. Electric bass follows a consistent two-beat bossa nova pattern. Drums feature a steady rimshot on the fourth beat of every measure with a light shaker and brushed hi-hats. Soft, breathy male vocals delivered in a relaxed, conversational style. Electric piano provides occasional jazz-inflected chord extensions and melodic fills. Tempo is 110 BPM in 4/4 time.
